stem.text: The graph shows the oxygen dissociation curves of haemoglobin from two species of mammal, **S** and **T**.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage saturation of haemoglobin with oxygen against partial pressure of oxygen in kPa, with two curves labelled S and T.

stem.text: Which statements could explain the difference in the oxygen dissociation curves of species **S** and species **T**?

items: Species **T** has a lower haemoglobin concentration in its red blood cells than species **S**.
The haemoglobin in species **T** has a lower affinity for oxygen than the haemoglobin in species **S**.
Species **T** lives at higher altitudes than species **S**.
